ctx.x: Joe Caulk sang "Mammy". The orchestra played "Russian Rag". Then a quartet did again a medley of "Mother of Mine", "Me, Oh Lord", and "Peaches Down In Georgia".
The orchestra played "Humoresque" and "Admiration". Then Miss Gee sang "Little Gal". Henry Saparo sang "Dixieland in France".
